title: Ladies Luncheon
public_detail: Palm Hill residents are invited to the September Ladies Luncheon on Wednesday, September 16, 2026, at 11:30 a.m. at Roosterfish Grill, 776 Missouri Avenue N, Largo, Florida. Guests can enjoy the restaurant’s Early Bird menu with reduced pricing. Please sign up in advance; the $5 reservation payment will be returned at the luncheon. Travel with friends and look for additional information on the North and South Clubhouse bulletin boards. Hostesses are Caroline ZImmerman at (937) 925-0644 and Lisa Bria at (727) 417-6724.
